video_title: Does LeBron Deserve ANOTHER Statue In LA?? Road Trippin' Gets HEATED

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron, Luka, AR trio not a championship contender
quotes.quote: I think the convenience of it works out for LeBron. But I don't think this is a championship contending team. I think they have some other very serious glaring holes that they need to address. So if I'm LeBron, I'll say, 'Hey, I'll come back. I just need to see what you bring back.' They need a new center.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need a makeover, DeAndre Ayton on his last straw
quotes.quote: They need a new makeover. The Lakers do. No seriously, they need a new makeover. And look, it's not just DeAndre Ayton, which by the way, I think he has a player option for his second year if I'm not mistaken, or is it guaranteed? Whatever it is, he better take that because if he don't take that or if he's not guaranteed, he won't be in the league. He's on his last straw. It's a wrap for him if he don't get his shit together, if the Lakers don't decide to waive him. I would bring back Marcus Smart.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron won't get a Lakers statue despite deserving one
quotes.quote: I'm not saying he shouldn't deserve one. I'm saying he's not going to get one. Lakers fans don't accept him. It's great. He's had better careers just in the Lakers than most other players. If we really want to look around, they just don't accept him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron deserves a statue at Crypto.com Arena for Lakers achievements
quotes.quote: Magic Johnson, James Worthy, Jeanie Buss, make the shit happen. Forget what y'all talking about. Forget what the Laker Nation don't accept and all that shit. LeBron has spent eight years playing for the Lakers. NBA championship, Finals MVP, breaking all type of records. Scoring records at that. Imagine being in a Laker uniform and passing up Kobe on the all-time scoring list. Then passing up Kareem on the all-time scoring list. Then hitting 40,000 in a Laker uniform. No, bro. That man deserves a statue in front of Crypto.com Arena.
